answer: Each agent identity is admitted only by a TPM/SGX enclave producing a zero-knowledge attestation of sealed code and hardware identity; the oasis state tree commits nonce history, pigment is its hash anchor, and horizon is the consensus contract. Forging identities requires physically compromising distinct certified silicon or computationally breaking the attestation circuit; admission bonds follow a quadratic curve, O(N^2), and fraud irreversibly slashes collateral.
